text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
âListen. Can you hear it? The voice of 
the plushie.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I'm so happy you were the one to 
win it for me," she said.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy too. Being able to hold such a 
lovely little pony in my arms, that is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Though if I'm being greedy... maybe I'd 
like to make even more friends for them?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Just kidding! But really, I'm truly happy 
from the bottom of my heart!
